year.description:
The representation of the year. For example:
- "numeric" (e.g., 2012).
- "2-digit" (e.g., 12).

month.description:
The representation of the month. For example:
- "numeric" (e.g., 3).
- "2-digit" (e.g., 03).
- "long" (e.g., March).
- "short" (e.g., Mar).
- "narrow" (e.g., M).

day.description:
The representation of the day. For example:
- "numeric" (e.g., 1).
- "2-digit" (e.g., 01).

hour.description:
The representation of the hour. For example:
- "numeric" (e.g., 1).
- "2-digit" (e.g., 01).

hour12.description:
The representation of 12 hour time.
- true (e.g. 01:00:00 PM)
- false (e.g. 13:00:00)

minute.description:
The representation of the minute. For example:
- "numeric" (e.g., 1).
- "2-digit" (e.g., 01).

second.description:
The representation of the second. For example:
- "numeric" (e.g., 1).
- "2-digit" (e.g., 01).

timeZoneName.description:
The representation for the name of the time zone. For example:
- "long" (e.g., Pacific Standard Time).
- "short" (e.g., PST, GMT-8).

timeZone.description: The time zone {@link TimeZone} to use.
